pipeline.description: Aggregation pipeline as a JSON array, e.g. [{"$match": {"active": true}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$category", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}]
pipeline.title: Pipeline

allow_disk_use.description: Allow MongoDB to write temporary files to disk for large aggregations exceeding 100MB memory limit
allow_disk_use.title: Allow Disk Use

x-dynamic-options.custom_placeholder: Or type the index name (default = default)

facets.description: Facet definitions as JSON. String facet: {"genre": {"type": "string", "path": "genre"}} — IMPORTANT: the indexed field must use "type": "token" in the Atlas Search index (not "string"). Numeric: {"price": {"type": "number", "path": "price", "boundaries": [0, 50, 100, 200]}}. Date: {"year": {"type": "date", "path": "date", "boundaries": ["2020-01-01", "2021-01-01"]}}
facets.title: Facets

x-dynamic-options.custom_placeholder: Or type the index name (default = default)

search_operator.description: Full $search operator as JSON for compound, phrase, autocomplete, range, etc. When provided, overrides the Query and Search Fields above. E.g. {"compound": {"must": [{"text": {"query": "coffee", "path": "name"}}], "should": [{"text": {"query": "organic", "path": "tags"}}]}}
search_operator.title: Search Operator (Advanced)

search_fields.description: Comma-separated field names to search in, e.g. "title,plot,description". Leave blank to search all indexed fields.
search_fields.title: Search Fields

fuzzy.description: Enable fuzzy matching to tolerate typos and spelling variations
fuzzy.title: Fuzzy Search

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
limit.title: Limit

operations.description: JSON array of write-operation dicts, e.g. [{"insertOne": {"document": {"x": 1}}}, {"updateOne": {"filter": {"x": 1}, "update": {"$set": {"y": 2}}}}]
operations.title: Operations

ordered.description: If true, aborts on first error. If false (recommended for imports), attempts all and collects errors.
ordered.title: Ordered

command.description: Database command as JSON, e.g. {"ping": 1} or {"serverStatus": 1}
command.title: Command

filter.description: Optional query filter as JSON (omit to count all documents)
filter.title: Filter

index_name.description: Name for the search index (use "default" to make it the default)
index_name.title: Index Name

dynamic.description: Auto-index all string fields when enabled. Disable to specify field mappings manually.
dynamic.title: Dynamic Mapping

field_mappings.description: Field mapping definitions as JSON array per field (used when Dynamic Mapping is disabled). E.g. {"title": [{"type": "string", "analyzer": "lucene.standard"}], "plot": [{"type": "string"}]}. Use "type": "token" for fields used in string facets (required by Atlas facet search).
field_mappings.title: Field Mappings

analyzer.description: Default analyzer for string fields, e.g. "lucene.standard", "lucene.english", "lucene.whitespace"
analyzer.title: Analyzer

size.description: Maximum size in bytes for a capped collection
size.title: Max Size (bytes)

max.description: Maximum number of documents in a capped collection
max.title: Max Documents

time_field.description: Field containing the date/time for time series collections (MongoDB 5.0+)
time_field.title: Time Field (Timeseries)

keys.description: Index key specification as JSON object. Use 1/-1 for ascending/descending, "text" for text search, "hashed" for hash sharding, "2dsphere"/"2d" for geospatial. Examples: {"email": 1} {"field1": 1, "field2": -1} {"content": "text"} {"loc": "2dsphere"}
keys.title: Keys

sparse.description: Only index documents that contain the indexed field
sparse.title: Sparse

hidden.description: Hide from query planner without dropping (MongoDB 4.4+)
hidden.title: Hidden

expire_after_seconds.description: Automatically delete documents after N seconds (TTL index). Must be on a Date field.
expire_after_seconds.title: Expire After Seconds (TTL)

partial_filter_expression.description: Only index documents matching this filter, e.g. {"status": "active"}
partial_filter_expression.title: Partial Filter Expression

collation.description: Language-specific string comparison rules as JSON, e.g. {"locale": "en", "strength": 2}
collation.title: Collation

indexes.description: JSON array of index spec objects, each with "keys" (required) and optional "name", "unique", "sparse", "expireAfterSeconds", "partialFilterExpression". E.g. [{"keys": {"email": 1}, "unique": true}, {"keys": {"createdAt": 1}, "expireAfterSeconds": 3600}]
indexes.title: Index Specifications

index_name.description: Name for the vector search index
index_name.title: Index Name

path.description: Name of the field storing the embedding vectors
path.title: Vector Field

num_dimensions.description: Number of dimensions in the embedding vectors (e.g. 1536 for text-embedding-3-small, 3072 for text-embedding-3-large, 768 for nomic-embed)
num_dimensions.title: Dimensions

filter_fields.description: Comma-separated field names to index as filter-type (for pre-filtering in vector search). E.g. "category,status,user_id". These fields must be boolean, date, number, objectId, string, or UUID.
filter_fields.title: Filter Fields
